crossRefs.note: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

translations.web: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
translations.bsb: Though his sons are many, they are destined for the sword; and his offspring will never have enough food.
translations.kjv: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
translations.asv: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword; And his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
